models.name: Bonsai 2 9B

engines.quant: ternary weights (-1/0/+1), ~2GB footprint, ~9x smaller than full precision; vendor figure, per-benchmark retention 92-100% on the 9B; the ternary GGUF packings need PrismML's llama.cpp fork (upstream loads only Q2_0)

models.why: PrismML's ternary Bonsai 2 9B puts reasoning, vision and tool calling in ~2GB and reports up to 179 tok/s on an M5 Max Pro (34 tok/s on an iPhone 18 Pro Max) — vendor numbers, but with per-benchmark retention published (92.4% tool calling, 100% instruction following).
